def ledger.era.alonzo.AlonzoTxOut.read.note: a list of two or three, definite or indefinite, each field by the flat output reader's reader of it, held to the flat output. The two read alike on the 83 outputs of the recorded Alonzo transactions (blocks, refusal, v1-context, context-matrix and Plutus admission corpora), the 71 they spend or the refusal corpora's UTxO sets hold, the 78 output items of the reference's Alonzo decoder corpora and 5,730 byte mutants of the distinct outputs and two crafted ones with a datum hash; the 15 answers of the reference's 19 Alonzo UTxO cases read, its 4 refusals refused, and its 9 verdicts on an output's form are the era decoder's. A refusal is the flat decoder's diagnostic, not the reference's (wrong number of terms, expected list len); the compact address its encoder writes is the address written again of an output of lovelace only (mkTxOutCompact, a bootstrap address as the reference encodes a Byron address), else the bytes read
